heading: Protection of transmission contracts in the Pacific Northwest

tree.heading: Definition of electric utility or person
tree.text: In this section, the term “electric utility or person” means an electric utility or person that—

children.text: as of August 8, 2005, holds firm transmission rights pursuant to contract or by reason of ownership of transmission facilities; and
in the Pacific Northwest, as that region is defined in section 839a of this title; or
in that portion of a State included in the geographic area proposed for a regional transmission organization in Commission Docket Number RT01–35 on the date on which that docket was opened.

tree.heading: Protection of transmission contracts
tree.text: Nothing in this chapter confers on the Commission the authority to require an electric utility or person to convert to tradable or financial rights—

children.text: firm transmission rights described in subsection (a); or
firm transmission rights obtained by exercising contract or tariff rights associated with the firm transmission rights described in subsection (a).
